name: Scan and Push — Honeycomb Scanner Protocol
description: Protocol for scanning all honeycombs and pushing updated registry to GitHub. Based on analysis of honeycomb_scanner.py v1.2.0.

what_scanner_does.scan_target: All folders inside honeycombs/ that contain index.json
what_scanner_does.change_detection: MD5 hash comparison with previous scan_state.json

sections.content.registry.honeycombs: Array of all hives with metadata

full_cycle_block: python3 honeycombs/registry/honeycomb_scanner.py scan && git add honeycombs/registry/registry.json honeycombs/registry/scan_state.json && git commit -m "feat: scan honeycombs — $(python3 -c "import json; f=open('honeycombs/registry/registry.json'); d=json.load(f); print(d['content']['registry']['statistics']['total_honeycombs'])") hives found, 0 errors" && git pull --rebase origin main && git push

steps.note: Look for: 'SCAN COMPLETE', 'Found hives: N', 'Validation errors: 0'

steps.command: git commit -m "feat: scan honeycombs — $(python3 -c "import json; f=open('honeycombs/registry/registry.json'); d=json.load(f); print(d['content']['registry']['statistics']['total_honeycombs'])") hives found, 0 errors"
git pull --rebase origin main && git push

notes: Scanner automatically updates registry.json and scan_state.json
All new honeycombs are registered as 'new_honeycombs'
If validation errors > 0 — fix honeycombs and rescan
Registry is the single source of truth about system state
Scanner does NOT auto-push — git commands are required
